plain: A training method where an AI critiques and improves answers, and labels which are better, using a short list of written principles instead of human harm labels.
eli5: The robot checks its own homework against a rule list and learns from its corrections.
technical: The method of Bai et al. (2022): a supervised stage in which the model critiques and revises its own answers against constitutional principles, then reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF), where a feedback model's comparisons against the principles replace human harmlessness labels.
